title: Relationships, Boundaries, and Coping with Major Pressures
summary: Ages 16-18 = deep relationships (friendship, love, family) + major pressures (future, identity, independence). Skills: (1) Healthy boundaries: polite "no," time for yourself, do not carry the responsibility of others' happiness. (2) Assertive communication: "I feel... when... and I need...". (3) Major pressures: break them into steps, seek help (mentor, therapist, hotline), do not face them alone. (4) Substance use/risks: a conscious decision based on your values, not peer pressure. You are building your adult personality now.
try_this: This week: Practice the "I-message" — write: "I feel [emotion] when [situation], and I need [need]." Practice with a friend or parent.
reflection_prompts: How did you feel using the "I-message"?
